material_coverage_findings.finding: The one-listed-document requirement, city/county birth-certificate qualification, Refugee I-797 condition and specific unacceptable arrival forms are omitted.

proposed_statements.statement: Present one document from the handbook’s accepted list to establish U.S. citizenship or lawful status and identity.
A city- or county-issued birth certificate may require additional identification documents.
A Refugee-stamped I-94 or I-94A may require an I-797.
Forms I-151, I-94W and I-94 Border Crosser are not accepted for this identity and lawful-status documentation pathway.

material_coverage_findings.finding: The complete temporary permanent-resident ADIT-stamp pathway is absent.

proposed_statements.statement: An unexpired ADIT stamp documenting temporary lawful admission for permanent residence until a stated date is accepted in a valid foreign passport.

For the temporary-resident endorsement wording specified after June 28, 2004, the valid foreign passport must show the one-year temporary I-551 permanent-resident statement with the properly placed admission stamp.

material_coverage_findings.disposition: coverage_gap; preserve both printed endorsement variants and their date, duration and passport/stamp conditions without reproducing the entire official stamp text
